faces.name: Xathrid Demon
faces.oracleText:
Flying, trample
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature other than this creature, then each opponent loses life equal to the sacrificed creature's power. If you can't sacrifice a creature, tap this creature and you lose 7 life.

faces.name: Xathrid Gorgon
faces.oracleText:
Deathtouch (Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
{2}{B}, {T}: Put a petrification counter on target creature. It gains defender and becomes a colorless artifact in addition to its other types. Its activated abilities can't be activated. (A creature with defender can't attack.)

faces.name: Xathrid Necromancer
faces.oracleText: Whenever this creature or another Human creature you control dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

faces.name: Xathrid Slyblade
faces.oracleText:
Hexproof (This creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
{3}{B}: Until end of turn, this creature loses hexproof and gains first strike and deathtouch. (It deals combat damage before creatures without first strike. Any amount of damage it deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
